 JEE Main Admit Card 2027- The National Testing Agency has announced the JEE Main 2027 session 1 admit card release date on the official website, j eemain.nta.nic.in. The JEE Main admit card 2027 for session 1 will be issued on January 13, 2027. To download the admit card for JEE Main 2027, candidates will need their application number and password. Candidates must download the JEE Main session 1 admit card 2027 and carry it to the examination centre. The JEE Main exam centre address, shift time, exam date and important guidelines will be mentioned on the admit card. The authority will conduct the JEE Main 2027 exam in online test. The JEE Main exam for session 1 is scheduled to be conducted on January 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, and 28, 2027.

 JEE Mains Admit Card 2027 Credentials Required
 Candidates need their JEE Main login credentials to download the admit card. To download the JEE Mains 2027 hall ticket, candidates require their application number and password. Candidates will be able to access the JEE admit card online only.
 NTA JEE Mains Admit Card Login Window
 How to Download NTA JEE Main 2027 Admit Card? 
 The NTA will issue the JEE Main admit card 2027 session 1 online. Only registered candidates will be able to download the JEE admit card. Applicants must follow the steps mentioned below to download the NTA JEE Main admit card. The detailed JEE Main 2027 admit card download process is provided below.
 How to Download JEE Main Admit Card 2027 Using the Application Number and Password
 Visit the JEE Main admit card 2027 link on the official website- jeemain.nta.nic.in.
 Click on the JEE Main hall ticket link.
 Choose ‘Through application number and password’.
 Enter the JEE application number and password.
 Click on the 'Sign In'
 The admit card for JEE Main will appear in the candidate's portal.
 Check the details in the JEE Mains hall ticket 2027 and download the same.

 Guidelines for examination
 JEE Mains 2027 Exam Day Guidelines
 Candidates appearing for the JEE Main exam have to follow a few exam guidelines. The authority mentions the complete guidelines on the JEE Main hall ticket. Below are a few important NTA JEE Main exam day guidelines to follow at the examination centre of JEE Main 2027.
 Students are advised to report to the test centre before the Gate closing time to avoid last-minute rushes. Since there will be security checks, they should make sure they arrive early.
 Candidates need to carry the JEE Main admit card 2027 along with a valid ID proof. Valid ID proofs: Aadhar, Passport, Voter ID, School ID/ PAN/ Driving License, etc.
 Candidates will be provided a scribble pad in the exam hall for rough work.
 Diabetes candidates will be allowed to carry eatables inside the exam hal,l such as sugar tablets/fruits and transparent water bottles. However, they will not be allowed to carry packed food such as chocolate, sandwiches, etc. inside the exam hall.
 Candidates have to sit in the seat allocated by the authorities.
 No electronic devices allowed - calculators, pagers, mobile phones and more are allowed inside the exam centre.
 Students will not be allowed to enter the exam centre after the exam commences or leave before it ends
 PwD certificate for the candidates claiming relaxation.
 Guidelines mentioned on JEE Main Admit Card 2027 
 JEE Main 2027 Dress Code
 The JEE Main hall ticket also provides the details on the appropriate dress code for the exam. The JEE Main dress code 2027 is the correct attire that a candidate must wear when taking the exam. Here are certain points for reference-
 Wear simple clothing and avoid those items that will hamper the security check process. They should not contain large buttons.
 Footwear with thick soles is not allowed.
 Avoid accessories like jewellery, goggles, a watch, etc.
 Correct the Discrepancies in JEE Main Hall Ticket 2027
 Candidates must check their JEE Main admit card 2027 for any discrepancies. There may be a chance of discrepancies in the JEE Mains 2027 admit card related to name, date of birth, gender, exam centre, city, category, etc. Candidates must contact the mentioned authorities in case of discrepancies in the JEE admit card.
 JEE Main Helpline Number - 011-40759000
 Email ID - jeemain@nta.ac.in
 Forgot Login Credentials for JEE Main Admit Card 2027 Download
 What to do if login details are forgotten? Check this section to know how to retrieve application number or change password to download the JEE Main 2027 admit card session 1.
 Forgot JEE Main 2027 Application Number?
 There may arise a case when the candidates forget their JEE application number . Students can follow the detailed steps below during such situations:
 Go to the JEE Main NTA official website, jeemain.nta.ac.in
 Click on the JEE Main admit card download link.
 Go to the ‘Forgot Application Number’ link.
 Enter name, father’s name, mother’s name, date of birth, state of eligibility, and security pin.
 The application number will be sent to the registered email ID and mobile number.
 Forgot JEE Main 2027 Password?
 There is a chance of forgetting the JEE Main password. Below are the steps to retrieve the password to download the JEE Main 2027 admit card.
 Visit the JEE Main official website
 Click on the admit card link.
 Go to the ‘Forgot Password’ link
 Candidates will have to answer the security question that they had previously selected while filling out the application form.
 A code will be sent to the candidate’s mobile number as an SMS.
 A reset link will be sent to the email id which has to be clicked.
 Now, a new password can be set by them.
 IIT JEE Main Admit Card: How to Download the Old Admit Card?
 Candidates will not be able to download the old IIT JEE Main admit card. The old JEE Main 2027 hall ticket download will not be available for download on the official website, jee main nta nic in 2027. Hence students need to get the latest hall ticket by providing the application number and password. After downloading the admit card, the candidate must take a printout of the same for future use.
 Problems in Downloading JEE Main Admit Card 2027
 Candidates might face issues in downloading the JEE Main 2027 admit card. The problem in downloading the JEE admit card may occur due to slow internet connectivity or a technical error. If anyone is unable to download the JEE Main 2027 admit card, they can follow the given steps.
 Check the network connectivity
 Try downloading the admit card of JEE Main after some time
 Clear the cache and cookies.
 Also, refreshing the browser repeatedly and then reloading it may work.
 Sometimes, the incognito mode is useful.
 If the issue still persists, contact the JEE Main 2027 officials through the Contact No. 011-40759000 or email them at jeemain@nta.ac.in.
 JEE Main 2027 Session 1 City Intimation Slip
 The National Testing Agency will release the city intimation slip for session 1 online on December 30, 2026. Aspirants will be able to check the JEE Mains city intimation 2027 using the JEE login credentials, such as application number and password. The city intimation slip of JEE Main will consist of the name of the test city where candidates have to appear for the exam.
 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
 Q: What is the JEE Main 2027 session 1 admit card release date? A: The JEE Main 2027 Session 1 admit card release date is January 13, 2027.
 Q: How can I check my JEE Main 2027 admit card? A: Candidates will be able to check the JEE Mains hall ticket for January 2027 session using the JEE login application number and password.
 Q: What are the documents required for JEE Main exam? A: Candidates must carry the JEE Main 2027 admit card along with the self-declaration (undertaking) downloaded from the NTA website, printed on A4 paper and duly filled. A simple transparent ballpoint pen, an additional photograph for the attendance sheet, a personal hand sanitizer (50 ml), and a transparent water bottle are also required.
 Q: What are the credentials needed to download the JEE Main 2027 admit card? A: The credentials required to download the NTA JEE Main admit card 2027 are the application number and password.
 Q: How will I know the date, time and venue of JEE Main exam 2027? A: Candidates will be able to check the JEE Mains admit card 2027 to know the exam date, time and venue.
 Q: Which is the compatible web browser for JEE Main admit card download? A: Candidates can select either of these web browsers namely Firefox and Chrome to access the JEE Main 2027 admit card link.
 Q: Which items can I take inside along with the JEE Main 2027 admit card? A: Apart from the admit card of JEE Main 2027, candidates can also carry sanitiser, ballpoint pen, a photograph, a transparent water bottle, masks, and gloves.
 Q: What should I do if I forget my JEE Main application number or password? A: If you forget your JEE Main application number or password, visit the official website jeemain.nta.ac.in and navigate to the "Contact" tab. On the login page, select either "Forgot Application Number?" or "Forgot Password?" to recover your credentials.
 Q: Can I change my exam centre after the JEE Main admit card has been issued? A: No, the allotted examination centre city cannot be changed under any circumstances after the JEE Main admit card has been issued.
 Q: What documents are required to be carried along with the admit card to the exam center? A: Candidates must carry a valid photo identification proof along with the JEE Main admit card to the exam center. Accepted ID proofs include Aadhaar card, PAN card, passport, driving license, and voter ID. The details on the ID proof must match those on the admit card.

 A flight attendant ensures passenger safety and comfort during flights. Key duties include conducting safety checks, assisting passengers, serving food and drinks, and managing emergencies.  A Flight Engineer monitors and operates an aircraft’s complex systems like engines, fuel, and hydraulics during flight, ensuring optimal performance and safety. They assist pilots with technical issues, conduct inspections, and maintain records. This role requires strong technical knowledge, problem-solving, and communication skills. Training usually involves a degree in aviation or aerospace engineering and specialised certification.

 An Aircrew Officer operates and navigates aircraft, ensuring safe flights and compliance with aviation regulations. Key duties include managing flight systems, conducting pre- and post-flight checks, and adhering to safety standards. The role typically requires working five days a week, with around 120 flight hours monthly. Employment may be contractual or permanent, depending on the airline.

 An aerospace engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains aircraft, spacecraft, and related systems. They apply physics and engineering principles to improve aerospace technologies, often working in aviation, defence, or space sectors. Key tasks include designing components, conducting tests, and performing research. A bachelor’s degree is essential, with higher roles requiring advanced study. The role demands analytical skills, technical knowledge, precision, and effective communication.

 An air hostess, or flight attendant, ensures passenger safety and comfort during flights. Responsibilities include safety demonstrations, serving meals, managing the cabin, handling emergencies, and post-flight reporting. The role demands strong communication skills, a calm demeanour, and a service-oriented attitude. It offers opportunities to travel and work in the dynamic aviation and hospitality industry.

 An aeronautical engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains aircraft and related systems. They work on components like engines and wings, ensuring performance, safety, and efficiency. The role involves simulations, flight testing, research, and technological innovation to improve fuel efficiency and reduce noise. Aeronautical engineers collaborate with teams in aerospace companies, government agencies, or research institutions, requiring strong skills in physics, mathematics, and engineering principles.

 A Safety Manager ensures workplace safety by developing policies, conducting training, assessing risks, and ensuring regulatory compliance. They investigate incidents, manage workers’ compensation, and handle emergency responses. Working across industries like construction and healthcare, they combine leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills to protect employees and maintain safe environments.

 An airline pilot operates aircraft to transport passengers and cargo safely. Responsibilities include pre-flight planning, in-flight operations, team collaboration, and post-flight duties. Pilots work in varying schedules and environments, often with overnight layovers. The demand for airline pilots is expected to grow, driven by retirements and industry expansion. The role requires specialized training and adaptability.
